name: Caesar 155mm Self-Propelled Gun
characteristics: Strength: Wheeled chassis gives much faster road displacement than tracked SPGs, valuable for shoot-and-scoot tactics
Limitation: Lighter armor protection than tracked SPGs like PzH2000; wheeled mobility is worse off-road than tracked
Estimated quantity available: Dozens delivered across multiple donation tranches
employment_notes: French-donated system that became one of Ukraine's most publicized artillery types; wheeled design specifically suits the rapid-displacement doctrine forced by drone-cued counter-battery fire
contrast_vs_traditional: Traditional artillery doctrine sited guns for sustained fire missions from a fixed position, trading exposure for volume of fire. Modern counter-battery radar and persistent drone spotting make dwell time itself the vulnerability, which is exactly what Caesar's wheeled "shoot and scoot" design answers — firing and displacing in under a minute is a direct doctrinal response to the kill chain doctrine.md describes collapsing to single-digit minutes, not a convenience feature.
